about_the_game:
You are one of the few chosen by the Lord of Chaos, destined to serve his scheme that has spanned billions of years. Thrown into a strange new world, all you can do is survive - and uncover the secrets hidden within it. Those secrets may be the only way to defeat the being who pulls the strings behind this world.

In Elcom, you decide how to live. This is a true, living world - and every choice you make shapes your own destiny.

Explore

The world of Elcom is literally endless. Travel freely across vast lands, dig deep into the earth, and discover hidden wonders.There are no limits - not in width, height, or depth.

Survive

It’s a beautiful, but merciless world.You’ll need food, water, clothing, and even mental stability to stay alive. Every day is a struggle against nature itself.

Craft

Use everything you find to research, craft, and build tools, structures, and technologies to improve your life. Almost everything in this world can be interacted with, studied, and used to create something new.

Encounter

This world is filled with all kinds of creatures - and humans.Each has its own traits and personality. Your actions and choices will affect how individuals and even entire communities respond to you.

Fight

Not every creature is friendly - not even humans. Your ultimate goal is survival, because only the living can uncover the truth.Enemies may become allies, and friends can betray you at any time. Stay sharp and think wisely.

Tame and Recruit

Only by learning the weaknesses or secrets of others can you make them follow you.A man’s greed, a beast’s hunger - uncover their desires, and you can turn them into allies, or even loyal followers.

Build

Everything in this world can be destroyed or rebuilt. The only limit is your imagination.

Grow

You can plant and cultivate almost anything here - if you understand it.Every plant has its own secret, like a sentient being. Only those who uncover these secrets can truly grow them. Some may bless you with great fortune; others may bring unimaginable horror.

Experience

This world is alive. It has seasons, day and night, storms, sunshine, clouds, and snow. Each moment holds its own difference, its own mystery, its own story.

Enjoy every second you spend in this world -because you never know when the one behind the curtain will set his final plan into motion.

short_description: Explore an endless open world — vast in width, length, and depth — filled with mysteries to uncover. Join up to 8 friends to survive, farm, mine, build, and fight together in a living world with day-night cycles, seasons, and dynamic weather.
